import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Flow {
        static final int MAXN = 300;
        static final int MAXE = 900000;
        int[] head = new int[MAXN];
        int[] to = new int[MAXE];
        int[] cap = new int[MAXE];
        int[] nxt = new int[MAXE];
        int ecnt;
        int[] level = new int[MAXN];
        int[] it = new int[MAXN];

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            ecnt = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            to[ecnt] = v; cap[ecnt] = c; nxt[ecnt] = head[u]; head[u] = ecnt++;
            to[ecnt] = u; cap[ecnt] = 0; nxt[ecnt] = head[v]; head[v] = ecnt++;
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                    if (cap[e] > 0 && level[to[e]] == -1) {
                        level[to[e]] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(to[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (int e = it[v]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                if (cap[e] > 0 && level[v] + 1 == level[to[e]]) {
                    int pushed = dfs(to[e], t, Math.min(f, cap[e]));
                    if (pushed != 0) {
                        cap[e] -= pushed;
                        cap[e ^ 1] += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int ans = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                System.arraycopy(head, 0, it, 0, head.length);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(s, t, 1 << 30);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    ans += pushed;
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static Flow flow = new Flow();
    static int n, t;
    static int S = 202, T = 203;
    static int rp, cp;
    static int in;
    static int[][] srcId = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] sinkId = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] mark = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] dist = new int[21][21];
    static char[][] grid = new char[21][21];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[21][21];
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
    }

    static void searchEdges(int a, int b) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mark[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') mark[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        q.add(new int[]{rp, cp});
        q.add(new int[]{a, b});
        dist[a][b] = 0;
        dist[rp][cp] = 0;
        mark[a][b] = 1;
        mark[rp][cp] = 2;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] now = q.poll();
            int r = now[0], c = now[1];
            if (mark[r][c] == 1 && grid2[r][c] > '0' && grid2[r][c] <= '9') {
                flow.addEdge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[r][c], 9);
            }
            if (mark[r][c] == 1 && dist[r][c] == t) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 0) {
                    mark[nr][nc] = mark[r][c];
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                } else if (mark[r][c] == 1 && valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 2 && dist[nr][nc] == dist[r][c] + 1 && grid2[nr][nc] > '0' && grid2[nr][nc] <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[nr][nc], 9);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        flow.init();
        in = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(srcId[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(sinkId[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(S, in, grid[i][j] - '0');
                    srcId[i][j] = in++;
                }
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rp = i;
                    cp = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(in, T, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                    sinkId[i][j] = in++;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9' && grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(srcId[i][j], sinkId[i][j], 9);
                }
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    searchEdges(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow.maxFlow(S, T));
    }
}
